hook: Here is what my GoMining dashboard actually shows.

scenes.narration: My miner is 114.45 terahash at 14.92 watts per terahash, with an 18.72 percent discount.
Yesterday the dashboard showed $4.30. This month so far, $77.53. All time, $888.99.
These are only my numbers. Rewards move with the bitcoin price and difficulty, so yours could be lower. This is not a promise or financial advice.

cta: Curious how digital mining works? The link is on my channel page.
